title: Validation rejects with 422, not the 400 the checklist names
evidence: handlers.go:204 writeValidationError uses http.StatusUnprocessableEntity (422); REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify says 'rejected (400)'
suggestion: No change required — 422 is a defensible code for semantic validation failure and the requirement (reject missing title/author) is met; noted only for cross-run comparability.

title: year is required beyond the spec (missing/0 year rejected)
evidence: handlers.go:62-65 validate() rejects year < 1450, so a POST without a year (defaults to 0) returns 422 though TASK.md only requires title and author
suggestion: Acceptable hardening, but a client omitting year cannot create a book; relax to optional year if strict spec adherence is desired.
